versions.changelog: 新增桌面版一键安装：让 AI 用一条命令装上会动的桌宠（免账号、免 key，默认宠物自动就位）。One-command desktop pet install (no account/key needed).

Version 0.3.0 of deskpeto introduces device code authorization and updates user connection instructions.

- Added device code (设备码) authorization flow for connecting DeskPeto MCP with zero copy-paste for users.
- Updated MCP connection instructions, prioritizing device code flow and moving manual token as fallback.
- Clarified which actions require connecting a token.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No changes to pricing, pet creation/installation, or in-chat pet summoning flows.

Version 0.2.0

- Added support for summoning an animated pet card directly in chat, using the pet-page.html template.
- Expanded usage to include in-chat pet display triggers such as "召唤桌宠" or "显示我的宠物".
- Provided detailed instructions for integrating with DeskPeto MCP for querying, summoning, and one-click installation.
- Clarified process for presenting personalized or shared pets in different host applications.
- Removed old skill-card.md and added new references/pet-page.html for dynamic pet rendering.

DeskPeto 0.1.0 initial release

- Turn user photos into personal AI desktop pets (ChatGPT/Codex Pet resource packs) and assist with installation.
- Support installation of free community pets from DeskPeto Shared Gallery.
- Step-by-step guidance for registration, photo upload, payment (on website only), image confirmation, download, and installation.
- No collection of user photos, passwords, or payment info in chat; all uploads and payments occur on deskpeto.com.
- Troubleshooting steps and comprehensive installation options for various platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows).
- Free trial access to public pets for users to experience before creating their own.
